description: Estimated price of international EXPRESS delivery (DHL, FedEx and other carriers) to or from Ukraine, door-to-door, in UAH (гривні). Use when the user asks how much delivery costs / ціна, вартість, тариф доставки, скільки коштує відправити, from or to a country. Documents up to 2 kg or parcels/cargo 0.1–70 kg, minimum chargeable weight 0.5 kg (0.1–0.5 kg is charged as 0.5 kg); heavier on request. Transit usually 5–7 days. Customs duty, VAT (мито, ПДВ) and customs clearance are NOT included. Always mention that the exact price is confirmed after document check: 911@semero.ua or WhatsApp +380638431010. Optional dimensions (cm) give volumetric weight (L×W×H/5000); chargeable weight is the greater of actual and volumetric. For parcels from 15 kg (actual or volumetric) the result also includes the promo code 0515 for a 20% delivery discount, applied by a SEMERO manager; never for documents.
